## The four promises

- [ ] Every number is cited; a missing value stays `null`, never an estimate.
- [ ] The service stays free to run (Cloudflare Free, GitHub free tiers).
- [ ] Reviewers report; they don't edit.
- [ ] Checks use only public, widely known practice.

## Checks

- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that failed before it.
- [ ] `cd server && npm test` passes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest checker/tests` passes.
- [ ] A new data source has its terms in `docs/DATA_SOURCES.md`.
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the diff.
